description: This file contains automated test cases for the VacancyAPI within the Recruitment module of the OrangeHRM project. It defines a test class that covers CRUD operations for vacancy records, using PHPUnit framework and various helper classes for setup and assertions.
external_methods: VacancyAPI -> method calls for CRUD operations

classes.name: VacancyAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the OrangeHRM Vacancy API endpoints, including create, update, delete, getAll, and getOne operations. It uses data providers to run multiple test cases defined in YAML files.
